lines.text: Jesus crosses the sea and gets out of the boat in the region of the Gerasenes, where a man with an unclean spirit meets Him.
The man lives in the tombs, and no one can restrain him with chains, and he cuts himself with stones.
The man runs to Jesus, calls Him Son of David, and says his name is Legion because they are many.

wrong_details.true: Son of the Most High God

lines.text: Jesus lets the demons enter the pigs, and the herd of about two hundred rushes into the sea and drowns.
The people find the man clothed and in his right mind, and he proclaims throughout the Decapolis what Jesus did.
